pages.text: Test a condition, running the action when true and the fallback when false. Either branch may be empty.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: Pay for the test and chosen branch. Reserve for the more expensive branch.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 + P + max(A,B) + 0.25*min(A,B), for condition P and branches A and B.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).

pages.title: What to Attach
pages.text: $(li)predicate$(br)Predicate / Insert one node$(br2)$(li)If true$(br)Action / Optional; one node at most
